label: Diagram 4
caption: Diagram 4 Ground supported floor – construction (see paragraph 4.7)
description:
Diagram 4, titled "Ground supported floor – construction (see paragraph 4.7)", shows four vertical sections of a floor in a two‑by‑two layout, labelled (a) to (d). Each section stacks horizontal layers, with a dashed line at the top labelled "Floor finish" and a layer of small shapes at the bottom labelled "Hardcore".

(a), captioned "Damp-proof membrane below slab", is headed "Insulation above slab". From the top: wavy "Insulation", grey "Concrete slab", dotted "Damp-proof membrane", "Blinding", then "Hardcore".

(b), captioned "Damp-proof membrane above slab", shows from the top: wavy "Insulation", "Damp-proof membrane", "Concrete slab", "Hardcore".

(c), captioned "Damp-proof membrane below slab", is headed "Insulation below slab". From the top: "Concrete slab", wavy "Insulation", "Damp-proof membrane", "Blinding", "Hardcore".

(d), captioned "Damp-proof membrane above slab", shows from the top: "Damp-proof membrane", "Concrete slab", wavy "Insulation", "Blinding", "Hardcore".
